plan.purpose: Determine whether a fixed small odor input helps or harms complete flights. Software sensitivity experiment, not a living-fly intervention or physical dose search.
plan.rationale: Both existing odor inputs changed commands at this level while retaining approximately the clean-air visual-step response in all four static contexts. Use the same level for both inputs, without further tuning.
plan.physics: Original full-flight timeouts and touchdown criteria, no warmup or truncation
plan.analysis: Matched changes in successful landings are primary; retain failure reasons and original rewards. No selection or deployment from this pilot alone.

interpretation: A fixed-readout software pilot on 16 prespecified matched starts. Record landing benefits and harms together. No chemical dose, biological effect, new controller selection or deployment is established.
